title: Supply, Installation and commissioning of CCTV system at Lambaline Officer's Colony under Sri Vijaya Puram Directorate
summary: E-tender for supply, installation and commissioning of a CCTV system at the Lambaline officers' colony of the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair), Andaman & Nicobar Islands.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair)

sites.name: Lambaline Officer's Colony, Sri Vijaya Puram
sites.work: Supply, installation and commissioning of CCTV system

scope.item: Supply, Installation and commissioning of CCTV system

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST. Cost of bid document Nil. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled nationalised bank (Hindi version: FDR or bank guarantee) in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Sri Vijaya Puram, valid 06 months from technical bid opening; originals by 28.12.2024 15:00. NSIC/MSME registered bidders considered for exemption of EMD/tender fee/past experience/turnover per Govt norms.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Reputed firms/contractors with experience in similar works with Central Govt/State Govt/PSU/public listed company in remote island of Andaman & Nicobar
Similar work: supply, installation, testing and commissioning of CCTV system
Initial eligibility criteria as per Section 3 (not included)
notes: Pages 3-7 of a 55-page tender document (Section I NIT, Hindi and English); Section 3 eligibility, specifications and BOQ not included.
